blurb: Taste award-winning wines and enjoy a gourmet dinner on this guided, half-day adventure. Visit three local wineries, tucked away in the vineyards and valleys of Niagara, Ontario's famous wine country. Sample crisp reds, whites, sweet, late harvest, and icewines. Then relax with a true culinary experience — a 3-course, gourmet dinner, using fresh, local herbs and ingredients prepared by one of Niagara's top chefs. This 'Best-Kept-Secret' dinner tour is a popular option for birthdays, anniversaries, a romantic date, or simply a unique day out. Transportation from area hotels is included.
